designationHistory.indexText: Established in 1953 when Presquile island was given to the United States under the will of A. D. Williams, as an inviolate sanctuary for migratory birds.

authority.citation: Bequest of A. D. Williams; Migratory Bird Conservation Act

designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Presquile National Wildlife Refuge, About Us

FWS, Eastern Virginia Rivers NWR Complex compatibility determinations (2026): Presquile NWR "officially established in 1953 when lands were transferred ... as a gift under the provisions of the will of Mr. A. D. Williams," under the Migratory Bird Conservation Act
FWS news release, Apr. 1, 1953: A. D. Williams bequeathed Presquile island to the Interior Department as a waterfowl haven

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Presquile National Wildlife Refuge was officially established in 1953 for use as an inviolate sanctuary, or for any other management purpose, for migratory birds.
